no_adcom_quote.quote: An advisory committee meeting was not held for this product. There were no novel or complex regulatory issues that required discussion at such a public forum.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the SEYSARA (sarecycline) NDA209521 approval. The FDA Multidiscipline Review explicitly states an AC meeting was not held because there were no novel or complex regulatory issues warranting discussion in a public forum. Consequently there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
